title: O.5
_context:
The equivalent length of the main lines, risers and branches will be determined.
The equivalent length of different fittings may be estimated on the basis of the
data presented in the Tables 8.O.2(a), 8.O.2(b) and 8.O.2(c) or from
manufacturer's specification. The total equivalent length is the sum of the
equivalent lengths of all pipes and fittings.
